supporting_observations.claim: A PowerShell window appeared on WS-ICHEN-01 at 13:42 UTC, which aligns with the user's report of activity around 13:40 UTC.
The PowerShell process was executed by the IT administrator sam.okafor.
The PowerShell command executed the script \\FILE-NWD-01\Admin\Apply-Updates.ps1, which is the organization's approved method for IT to patch workstations.
Following the script execution, the Windows Update agent (wusa.exe) was used to install a specific patch (kb5047001), and the system connected to download.windowsupdate.com.

unrelated_findings: User ivy.chen is accessing files on a P: drive with names and extensions (e.g., .rkr) that appear encoded or obfuscated (T044-00094, T044-00108, T044-00265).
User ivy.chen is using a browser to access a Citrix StoreWeb URL (T044-00163, T044-00172) and a Webex executable is being used to navigate to a Slack URL (T044-00168).
The domain controller (DC-NWD-01) attempted to connect to WS-ICHEN-01 on ports 8080, 443, and 445, all of which were rejected (T044-00127, T044-00130, T044-00132, T044-00134).
